claim_judgments.rationale: Claim C0000 accurately captures the entitlement under 5 U.S.C. 6323(a)(1) for qualifying Federal and District of Columbia employees to leave without loss in pay, time, or performance/efficiency rating for active duty, inactive-duty training, funeral honors duty, or field/coast defense training as a Reserve, National Guard member, or Space Force member in space force active status not on sustained duty, subject to paragraph (2). All dimensions are faithfully represented.

Claim C0001 faithfully states the accrual rule under 5 U.S.C. 6323(a)(1), providing that leave accrues at the rate of 20 days per fiscal year and accumulates for use in the succeeding fiscal year up to a total of 20 days at the start of a fiscal year.

Claim C0002 accurately sets forth the part-time career employment prorated accrual calculation pursuant to 5 U.S.C. 6323(a)(2), dividing 40 into the regularly scheduled workweek hours during that fiscal year.
Claim C0003 accurately states the minimum leave charge under 5 U.S.C. 6323(a)(3) of one hour and additional charges in multiples of one hour.

Claim C0004 completely and accurately states the substantive leave entitlement under 5 U.S.C. 6323(b) for law enforcement/civil assistance military service and contingency operation active duty, including all qualifying employee and military status criteria.
Claim C0005 accurately states the 22-workday per calendar year limitation on leave granted under 5 U.S.C. 6323(b).

Claim C0006 correctly states the employee's option upon request to have qualifying subsection (b)(2) absence charged to accrued annual leave or available compensatory time instead of subsection (b) military leave.
Claim C0007 accurately reflects the statutory prohibition in 5 U.S.C. 6323(b) that the period of absence may not be charged to sick leave.

Claim C0008 correctly captures 5 U.S.C. 6323(c), providing leave without loss in pay or time for members of the D.C. National Guard ordered or authorized under D.C. Code title 39 for parades or encampments.

Claim C0009 accurately reflects 5 U.S.C. 6323(d)(1) governing military reserve technicians on active duty without pay outside the U.S., its territories, and possessions, up to 44 workdays in a calendar year.
Claim C0010 accurately captures 5 U.S.C. 6323(d)(2) permitting employees otherwise entitled to annual leave or compensatory time to receive it without regard to section 6323 or section 5519.

Claim C0011 faithfully sets forth the authorization under section 8023 of Pub. L. 107-117 to use appropriated funds for pay, allowances, and benefits of qualifying military reservists and National Guard members who request and are granted leave.

Claim C0012 accurately captures the proviso of section 8023 of Pub. L. 107-117 entitling employees requesting leave under subsection (3)(A) for service described in subsection (2) to such leave subject to the last sentence of 5 U.S.C. 6323(b).

unit_judgments.rationale: Claim C0000 accurately conveys the complete meaning, scope, and exceptions of 5 U.S.C. 6323(a)(1) military leave entitlement.
Claim C0001 fully preserves the accrual rate and accumulation ceiling for leave under subsection (a).
Claim C0002 fully retains the part-time career employment accrual formula under 5 U.S.C. 6323(a)(2).
Claim C0003 fully retains the one-hour minimum charge and multiple-of-one-hour rule under 5 U.S.C. 6323(a)(3).
Claims C0004 and C0005 together completely cover the entitlement, qualifying conditions, and the 22-workday calendar year ceiling under 5 U.S.C. 6323(b).
Claim C0006 completely covers the permission to charge subsection (b)(2) absences to accrued annual leave or compensatory time upon request.
Claim C0007 fully preserves the prohibition against charging the absence to sick leave.
Claim C0008 completely covers the D.C. National Guard parade and encampment leave entitlement under 5 U.S.C. 6323(c).
Claim C0009 completely retains the 44-workday leave entitlement for military reserve technicians on active duty without pay outside the United States under 5 U.S.C. 6323(d)(1).
Claim C0010 completely captures the elective use of annual leave or compensatory time under 5 U.S.C. 6323(d)(2).
Claim C0011 completely covers the authorization to use appropriations for pay, allowances, and benefits under Pub. L. 107-117, § 8023.
Claim C0012 completely captures the proviso entitlement and integration with 5 U.S.C. 6323(b) under Pub. L. 107-117, § 8023.

No claim in the draft was created to extract or represent the statutory note from Act July 1, 1947, ch. 192, § 4 defining officers and employees and providing military leave accrual rules for substitute postal field service employees.
